## Description

From the last 90 days of use movements, each item shows the expected days until it reaches its reorder level.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Items with under 30 days of history show "Not enough history".
- [ ] **AC2.** The forecast states its method in words.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
